## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 431 captures during October 2019. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Activity was completed in accordance with the clinic’s operating arrangements for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 431 captures, 5 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.2 per cent. The image quality results indicate that most captures were suitable for grading. The ungradable captures were recorded as part of the routine monthly review.

## Grading

Grading identified 76 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This provides a summary of the time taken for results to progress through the grading process during October 2019. Overall, the site maintained planned activity, with the recorded image quality and grading results reported above.
